text:
Media asset table for copy grounding (from media-preparation). Full literal descriptions: /Users/scottscheferman/nick-salazar-website/analysis/verification/media/content-descriptions.md; provenance: .../reconciliation.md; manifest: site/assets/MANIFEST.md.

KEY HONESTY FACTS
- All 7 videos + all poster-*.jpg are AI-generated (Grok). All videos have NO audio. Each AI clip is a recoloured, animated re-staging of one of the 7 client photos (same composition), so pair them as "real photo + AI illustration of the same scene", never as footage of a job.
- The 7 hero/photo-*.jpg are client-supplied originals (from IMG_*.HEIC) but nothing is verified: no location, date, job, client, outcome, or person.
- Visible marks that must NOT be named in copy: "HARGIS …" (crane, 03/photo-crane), "Seacom", "CAI", "BAHRI", container numbers CNEU 1621xx (05/photo-yard), "WFS", "DOL 3796", "…WITHOUT A SIDA BADGE" sign (07/photo-skid), "ONLY FOR LASHING" straps + desiccant logo (04/photo-drums), coil emblem + handwritten figures (02/photo-coils). Small people are visible in 03, 07, hero, photo-crane, photo-skid (faces not distinguishable).
- Source has 7 videos, not 8. Nothing was dropped.

VIDEOS (src relative to site/index.html; all 1168x768, 10.04 s, 24 fps, h264, muted, faststart)
1. assets/videos/01-hero.mp4 | poster assets/photos/poster-01-hero.jpg (1920x1280) + poster-01-hero-960.jpg (960x640) | AI | B&W low-angle sky; lattice crane + long spreader beam; red slings hold a large YELLOW finned rectangular unit mid-air; dark deck structures below | role: hero / heavy-lift | re-stages hero.jpg
2. assets/videos/02-coils.mp4 | poster-02-coils.jpg (1168x768) + -960 (960x631) | AI | B&W steel shed; stacked steel coils end-on with RED faces, dark bands, labels, chalk numbers | role: coils / steel pipe-plate-coil | re-stages photo-coils.jpg
3. assets/videos/03-crane.mp4 | poster-03-crane.jpg (1920x1280) + -960 | AI | B&W outdoor; black crawler crane lifts an ORANGE rectangular unit on yellow slings onto a flat railcar; one hard-hat figure; trailers on horizon | role: crane / heavy-lift / railcar loading | re-stages photo-crane.jpg
4. assets/videos/04-drums.mp4 | poster-04-drums.jpg (1920x1280) + -960 | AI | inside a dark-grey container; tall YELLOW cylindrical units braced by pale timber frame + orange lashing straps; desiccant bags on walls | role: containers / stowage-lashing / CSC | re-stages photo-drums.jpg
5. assets/videos/05-containers.mp4 | poster-05-containers.jpg (1920x1280) + -960 | AI | B&W outdoor yard, dark clouds; three long NAVY-tarped, netted objects on three flat-rack containers (racks grey → red during clip); light masts | role: yard / loading-stowage | re-stages photo-yard.jpg
6. assets/videos/06-warehouse.mp4 | poster-06-warehouse.jpg (1920x1280) + -960 | AI | B&W tall industrial hall; open plywood crate with timber cribbing holds a long BLUE-wrapped machine | role: warehouse / packing-crate survey | re-stages photo-warehouse.jpg
7. assets/videos/07-yard.mp4 | poster-07-yard.jpg (1920x1280) + -960 | AI | NOTE: indoor scene despite name — B&W warehouse floor; four tall YELLOW rounded-top units on a white roller dolly; hi-vis person walking in background; forklift at right | role: warehouse / stock-throughput (airfreight-adjacent) | re-stages photo-skid.jpg

PHOTOS (all 1920x1440, colour, client originals, unverified)
- assets/photos/hero.jpg | grey finned unit with yellow circular plates on a spreader beam under hazy blue sky, red-brown crane boom | safe: "Heavy unit lifted on a spreader beam"
- assets/photos/photo-coils.jpg | galvanised silver coils stacked in a corrugated shed, labels + handwritten figures | "Galvanised steel coils in a covered store"
- assets/photos/photo-crane.jpg | blue crawler crane, grey unit with red ladder onto red flat railcar, deep blue sky, hi-vis person, white pickup | "Crawler crane loading a heavy unit onto a railcar"
- assets/photos/photo-drums.jpg | copper-brown cylinders in a red container, timber bracing, orange straps | "Cylindrical cargo braced and lashed inside a container"
- assets/photos/photo-skid.jpg | grey rounded-top units on a white roller dolly in a warehouse, hi-vis person, forklift | "Crated units staged on a dolly in a cargo warehouse" (scene of 07-yard.mp4)
- assets/photos/photo-warehouse.jpg | open plywood crate with timber cribbing, white-film-wrapped machine, yellow overhead crane rail | "Wrapped machinery blocked and braced in a timber crate"
- assets/photos/photo-yard.jpg | navy-tarped cargo on red flat-racks in a paved yard, yellow mobile crane at left, grey sky | "Tarped project cargo on flat-rack containers" (scene of 05-containers.mp4)

Ask me if you need a different crop, a caption check, or any additional literal detail.
